qwen.byte_content_bound: For this downloaded tokenizer, <= UTF-8 byte length after normalization, before chat-template framing: each normalized byte has a vocabulary token and BPE only merges. Splitting does not duplicate bytes; configured ByteLevel pretokenizer does not prepend a space. Special tokens consume at most one token per nonempty recognized string.
qwen.remaining_assumption: Provider must use equivalent tokenizer and bounded chat framing; neither is guaranteed by public IDs or this offline inspection.
